name: Filter External Link Icon
description: A text filter that marks external links with an icon.
project_description:
This module helps with marking external links inside formatted text fields.

 It provides a text filter plugin that appends a span element - ↗ - at the end of anchor tags with external links. The content of this span is configurable and can be left empty if you wish to set a CSS background image on it instead.

 How to use:

 1. Enable the module

2. Visit /admin/config/content/formats

3. Configure your text format

4. Enable "Mark External Links"

5. (Optional) Configure the content of the span appended at the end of external links
